final: SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tx2 ON tx2.transreg = ab2.translink JOIN trader tr2 ON tr2.tradereg = tx2.trdref) AS share_of_analyses FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind
